author: Animalogic
description:
Dogs are our best friends, but in our efforts to make them better at certain jobs or simply just cuter, we haven't been the best friends to them. Intensive breeding has led to inbreeding and this has caused a huge number of health problems. So what can be done? How can we improve the lives of these animals, who have given us so much? Let's find out!
